show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/gqNH5E
show.description: A highly trained fighter enters the life of a brilliant pharma CEO disguised as an ordinary security guard to protect her. She has invented a drug called 'Sunspire',  a breakthrough that could potentially cure cancer. But a powerful businessman is determined to seize this discovery for himself. During the mission, the fighter uncovers a terrifying truth, the businessman’s father was responsible for destroying his family. What began as a protection mission soon turns into a deeply personal war.
